hooks.command: case "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH" in *.py) echo '--- [hook] ruff ---'; ./.venv/Scripts/ruff.exe check src/ tests/ 2>&1 | tail -n 15; echo '--- [hook] pytest ---'; ./.venv/Scripts/pytest.exe -q 2>&1 | tail -n 15 ;; esac

FAIL=0; ./.venv/Scripts/ruff.exe check src/ tests/ > /tmp/ruff_result.txt 2>&1 || FAIL=1; ./.venv/Scripts/mypy.exe --strict src/ > /tmp/mypy_result.txt 2>&1 || FAIL=1; ./.venv/Scripts/pytest.exe --cov=src --cov-fail-under=85 -q > /tmp/pytest_result.txt 2>&1 || FAIL=1; if [ $FAIL -eq 1 ]; then printf '{"decision": "block", "reason": "품질 기준 미달. /tmp/ruff_result.txt, /tmp/mypy_result.txt, /tmp/pytest_result.txt 확인 후 code-reviewer 서브에이전트로 재진단하세요."}'; exit 2; fi
